issue: The --extend warning says 'Pass --convergence-mode=off or use stopPolicy max-iterations to keep it running.' Neither works on an extended run. step_extend_completed_run rewrites only status, maxIterations, maxDurationMinutes, lineageMode and continuedFromRun in the config.
